headline: Apollo economist: AI gives no financial payoff outside tech
script: AI has delivered zero financial payoff to big companies outside the tech industry. That is the finding of Torsten Slok, the chief economist at Apollo Global Management. He looked at a group he calls the S and P four ninety-three. That means the S and P five hundred minus seven tech giants, including Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia and Tesla. In that group, profit margins and revenue per worker look flat. There is no evidence that AI is improving productivity. Slok said companies have made massive investments despite all the hype. He is skeptical that non-tech firms are simply lagging behind the tech giants. He argued it will be tough to turn cheap intelligence into higher revenue growth. He wrote that AI may be a great calculator, but in business, intelligence is mostly judgment. He added that AI does not understand accountability, trust, culture, or fairness. Recent studies also found that AI has not yet delivered significant productivity gains.
